name: Heroes of Glory
author: Addicting Games
description: It isn't glory that makes a hero its the quality of their character, its the strength of their convictions, the ability to stand defiant in the face of tyranny! The glory is just the cherry on top. In Heroes of Glory, you will recruit your own custom team of fighters, mages, archers, and all kinds of fantasy races and train them to defeat your enemies. You will vanquish evil and defend your homeland via PvP battles and a new way to approach arena battles. Heroes of Glory is a massively multiplayer online role-playing game which will allow you to customize your party, upgrade their skills and build an empire. You are the sacred warriors of your own nation-state. You must not only fight typical fantasy minions but the never-ending threats from the border.
